description: Executes a whole Workflow Orchestrator pipeline as a single Tapis job. Runs each step's container in topological order inside one allocation.

jobAttributes.description: One job, one queue wait, the whole pipeline.

notes.why: Every submitted job sends all of these explicitly: the exec target follows whether any step needs a GPU, the resource fields are the pipeline-wide envelope, and the exec dirs are computed per site (see backend/engine/transactions.py _exec_system_dirs). Tapis fills any field a job OMITS from this definition, so a value baked in here would silently override a run that targets a different site. The numbers above are placeholders Tapis requires, never what a real pipeline job uses.
